topics.title: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO, sparking political and market scrutiny
topics.explanation: Nvidia’s chief executive Jensen Huang was reinstated after a brief resignation, prompting a Senate hearing, Capitol Hill grilling, and comments from President Trump that the move is good for the U.S. economy. The stock rallied then slipped as analysts and lawmakers debated the implications.
topics.why_it_matters: Nvidia is a key driver of the AI boom; changes at its helm affect its share price, AI-related financing deals, and can influence broader tech market sentiment.

topics.title: Anthropic shares tumble below IPO price as AI rally fades
topics.explanation: Anthropic’s stock fell 8%-9% after opening above its $83 IPO price, slipping back below that level. Analysts remain cautiously optimistic, noting the company’s large AI market opportunity despite the volatile start.
topics.why_it_matters: Anthropic is one of the few publicly traded AI firms; its price swings signal investor sentiment toward AI stocks after the recent Nvidia-driven rally.

topics.title: European gas prices surge and Saudi Arabia trims its growth outlook as oil markets shift
topics.explanation: Europe’s gas benchmark (TTF) jumped 163% over the past year, reaching four-year highs, while Saudi Arabia revised its economic-growth forecast to a 2.1% contraction after recovering oil exports mitigated some of the slump.
topics.why_it_matters: Higher gas prices raise energy costs for European industries and households, and Saudi’s slower-than-expected growth signals weaker demand for oil, influencing global commodity markets.

topics.title: U.S. Army weapons-storage review and court approval for ammunition detonation in Iowa
topics.explanation: The Army ordered a nationwide review of weapons-storage facilities after deteriorated explosives were found, and a federal court cleared the agency to detonate degraded ammunition at an Iowa plant amid public health concerns.
topics.why_it_matters: Safety reviews and disposal actions can affect defense-contract spending and local economies, and they highlight regulatory scrutiny of military infrastructure.
